content.value: A triangular notch is applied to measure the flow rate through a canal whose maximum capacity is 1.4 m³/sec. for a flow rate of 6 liter/s, the depth of water over the notch becomes 0.15 m. Determine the top width and depth of the notch assuming Cd=0.85.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
